pageProps.title: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever (2022)
pageProps.review: Black Panther: Wakanda Forever is a film that leaves disappointments in the emergence of a new protagonist and action direction, but conveys deep sadness and personal meaning through the empty space left by the previous protagonist.
pageProps.content:
## Review The appearance of the new Black Panther fell short of expectations, and even the impact of the action was lacking, making it feel weak. The overall story did not escape the predictable range, and it was hard to find overwhelming visuals or action sequences to offset this.
Most of all, his absence felt so large that deep regret and sadness remained throughout the movie.
But personally, it is a meaningful movie.
